_: Every test.skip() in e2e/race is registered here, and scripts/check-race-skips.mjs refuses one that is not. A `title` is the case's full name — every describe title down to the leaf, joined with ' > ' — because a leaf title alone can name two different cases. That is not unique either, so the checker refuses a name matching more than one collected case rather than counting it once. An entry either names the test that keeps its reason true (`guardedBy` — that test failing or disappearing is how the reason's expiry surfaces), or states in `unguarded` that nothing does and what observation would settle it. The prose reason stays in the comment beside the skip; what is here is the link a reader cannot make by eye.

collect._: A FLOOR on what --project=race collects, per file. Everything else in this ledger asks about the cases Playwright did collect, so a case that stops being collected is invisible to it: short of a total collection failure, deleting a case or a whole file leaves every other assertion satisfied and check:skips green. A minimum rather than an exact count — adding cases must not be a chore, and what this guards against is loss. check-race-skips.mjs prints every file that has grown past its floor, in this shape, so raising one deliberately is a copy-paste.

guardedBy.title: planProblems > refuses a wire whose source resolves to no rule at all

skips.title: T3b undo > a sampleRate-touching entry is refused while live
skips.unguarded: The reason is that no sampleRate entry can exist while live: the rate picker is disabled from the session start (pinned by 'the live session > locks the model picker and the other device actions for its duration' in src/main.device.test.ts) and the readback re-authors the plan. The SECOND half is NOT pinned, and an attempt to pin it there was withdrawn on 2026-08-13 after instrumentation showed the test vacuous: driving a CONSOLE edit and reading the Edit menu's IPC state — set_edit_menu_state, the only observable of undo depth outside a trace build — reports canUndo true from an OPEN, uncommitted entry, while the stack itself stays at u=0 r=0 for the whole run. PlanHistory.record() and .reset() are never called, so deleting rerenderPlan's planHistory reset changes nothing the test can see and it passes either way. What would settle it: an observable that separates a committed entry from an open one — the depth on the VITE_TRACE probe — or a unit test over PlanHistory itself asserting reset() drops both stacks, together with a reading that the fetch path reaches it.

skips.title: T3b undo > a .urxf settings import empties both stacks
skips.unguarded: The reason is that e2e/race/fake-device.ts answers false for experimental_enabled, so the import is unreachable from the harness. Nothing asserts that: chrome.spec.ts's --experimental case drives the OTHER stub (e2e/tauri-stub.ts) and checks the Device menu's self-test entry, not this path. What would settle it: an ordinary-tier case asserting #btn-open-settings is hidden without --experimental, plus a reading that the race fake still answers false.

skips.title: T3b undo > a cancelled Fetch re-points the MIDI bound cache
skips.unguarded: Not a claim about the app: the case is skipped because it belongs with t4-midi.spec.ts's learn helpers rather than as a second copy here. Nothing can expire, and nothing settles it except writing it there. Listed so the count of unwritten cases is countable rather than buried.

skips.title: T4b midi > Toggle (state) mode: a same-state message consumes the guard
skips.unguarded: The reason is that the harness has no observable that separates the two outcomes — in state mode the incoming value IS the state. It expires the moment one appears, and the trace probe is where that would come from. What would settle it: a reading in __urxTrace (or the fake's IPC) that distinguishes a consumed guard from an unconsumed one.
